home_hero_subtitle: Find the right route, vehicle and carrier for your cargo in one place.
about_hero_description: Tranzit.AZ is a cargo listing platform that accelerates connections in the freight market with a clear and convenient workflow.
about_paragraphs: Tranzit.AZ is an online cargo listing platform that simplifies communication between cargo owners, drivers and transport companies.
On the platform, cargo owners can post their listings for free, while drivers and transport companies can easily find matching loads and get in touch.
about_advantages: Save time — drivers find you, not the other way around.
Search by cargo type, vehicle and city
New order opportunities for drivers and transport companies
Direct call and communication without intermediaries
Drivers can view loads and call without registration
howitworks_description: Tranzit.AZ is not a marketplace. The platform publishes cargo listings and connects drivers directly with cargo owners.

howitworks_steps.title: Easy cargo listing
howitworks_steps.text: The cargo owner registers and fills out the cargo form in a few clicks.

howitworks_steps.title: Confirmation time
howitworks_steps.text: Your listing is reviewed within minutes and published if it complies with the rules.

howitworks_steps.title: Accessible listing page
howitworks_steps.text: Your listing appears on the main page and becomes accessible to drivers.

howitworks_steps.title: Direct call
howitworks_steps.text: Individual drivers contact you directly and agree on the details of the shipment.

terms_intro: Every user who uses the Tranzit.AZ platform is considered to have agreed to these terms. Users are responsible for the accuracy of the listing information they post.
terms_s1_paras: Cargo listings on the platform are activated after review by an administrator. The responsibility for the accuracy of the listing data, the validity of the contact number, and the accuracy of the cargo description rests with the user who placed the listing.
terms_s2_paras: Tranzit.AZ acts as an information and communication intermediary between cargo owners and carriers. Price, delivery time, loading, transportation, payment method and other terms are agreed directly between the parties.
terms_s3_paras: The platform is not directly liable for delays, damage or loss of cargo, payment disputes, driver behaviour or other misunderstandings between parties. Users should verify the counterparty's information before reaching an agreement.
terms_s4_paras: It is prohibited to post false, offensive, misleading, illegal listings or those that violate the rights of third parties. The platform reserves the right to delete such listings, restrict or block users without warning.
terms_s5_paras: Cargo listings remain active for the period selected by the user. After the period expires, the listing automatically moves to the expired section. Users may restore it and send it for re-approval by an administrator.
priv_s1_paras: When using the platform, data such as name, surname, phone number, email address, company information, listing data, and pickup/delivery addresses may be provided.
priv_s2_paras: The contact number shown in cargo listings is publicly visible to allow carriers to contact cargo owners directly.
priv_s3_paras: The provided data is used for registration, listing management, admin approval, and user account functionality.
priv_s4_paras: Tranzit.AZ takes necessary technical and organisational measures to store user data securely.
priv_s5_paras: User data is not sold or transferred to third parties without permission.
priv_s6_paras: Users can edit some data in their personal account. Requests for data deletion are reviewed by the platform administration.
priv_s7_paras: The platform may use cookies and similar technical data to improve user experience.
priv_s8_paras: By using the platform, the user is considered to have accepted the terms of this privacy policy.
